start: Admin app, Trainers page, one ticked trainer with working hours set, a member on the gym list

steps.action: Open the Trainers page
user_sees: This week, Monday to Sunday, with each ticked trainer, what they teach and their hours
Each member's count of classes booked from now on
must_not: A trainer from another gym or a removed staff member in the list
Bookings of another week mixed in

steps.action: Pick the trainer, the member, tomorrow at 7:00 am, 60 minutes, and press Book
user_sees: The class in the week at 7:00 to 8:00 with the name of who booked it
must_not: Two classes after one press
A class saved outside the trainer's hours without asking first

steps.action: Cancel that class
user_sees: The slot is free again and the member's count of classes ahead goes down by one
must_not: The cancelled class still counted or still shown in the week

start: Admin app, Trainers page, a ticked trainer with no page yet

steps.action: Open the trainer, type what they teach, set Monday to Saturday 6:00 to 11:00, add a photo, save
user_sees: The trainer's page with the teaching line (at most 80 letters), the hours and the photo
must_not: A photo over 100 KB or not a JPEG saved
Overlapping hours kept as two shifts

steps.action: Change only the hours and save again
user_sees: The new hours, the same photo
must_not: The photo removed because it was not sent again

start: Admin app, Trainers page, a trainer with a class tomorrow at 7:00 am

steps.action: Try to book the same trainer tomorrow 7:30 for another member
user_sees: A refusal that says the trainer is busy then
must_not: A second class saved over the first

steps.action: Try to book today at a time that has already gone, and a day 40 days ahead
user_sees: A refusal for a time in the past
A refusal for a day too far ahead
must_not: A class saved in the past or more than 31 days ahead

steps.action: Try to book at 3:00 pm when the trainer's hours end at 11:00 am
user_sees: A question first: the time is outside the trainer's hours
must_not: A class saved outside the hours with no question

start: Admin app, Trainers page, a class that started 10 minutes ago

steps.action: Cancel the class that has started
user_sees: The class leaves the week
must_not: A refusal for the owner

steps.action: Cancel the same class again from a second tab that still shows it
user_sees: A word that the class is no longer there
must_not: Two cancel records or an error with no words

start: Admin app, Trainers page, a trainer page with a photo

steps.action: Open the week signed in at this gym, then sign in at a second gym
user_sees: Only this gym's trainers, photos and bookings each time
must_not: Another gym's trainer photo, member or booking
The member's phone or money shown on a booking

start: Admin app signed in as front desk, Trainers page, a ticked trainer with free time tomorrow

steps.action: Open the Trainers page
user_sees: The week with every ticked trainer and their bookings
must_not: A Save button on a trainer's page for the desk

steps.action: Book the trainer for a member tomorrow at 6:30 am for 45 minutes
user_sees: The class in the week with the desk person's name as who booked it
must_not: Two classes after one press
The class under another trainer

start: Admin app as front desk, Trainers page, a class that started 5 minutes ago

steps.action: Try to change a trainer's page
user_sees: A word that only the owner can change it
must_not: The page saved

steps.action: Try to cancel the class that has started
user_sees: A word that only the owner can cancel it now
must_not: The class cancelled

steps.action: Try to book a member who was deleted from the list
user_sees: A refusal that the member is not on the list
must_not: A class for a member who is not on the list

start: Admin app as front desk, a class tomorrow

steps.action: Cancel the class
user_sees: The slot is free and the count of classes ahead goes down
must_not: The class still in the week

steps.action: Book the same slot again for the same member
user_sees: A new class in that slot
must_not: A refusal because of the cancelled class

start: Admin app signed in as a ticked trainer, Trainers page

steps.action: Open the Trainers page
user_sees: The week with every trainer's classes, own classes among them
must_not: A trainer who was removed still listed

steps.action: Book a class for a member they train, the day after tomorrow at 8:00 am
user_sees: The class under their own name with them as who booked it
must_not: A class saved during another class of theirs

start: Admin app as a trainer, own trainer page

steps.action: Open their own page, change what they teach and their hours, save
user_sees: Their page with the new words and hours
must_not: Another trainer's page changed

start: Admin app as a trainer, another trainer's page

steps.action: Try to save another trainer's page
user_sees: A word that only the owner can change it
must_not: The other trainer's page changed

steps.action: Try to book a member at a time the member already has a class
user_sees: A refusal that the member is busy then
must_not: Two classes for one member at once

start: Admin app as a trainer, a class of theirs that started 15 minutes ago and one tomorrow

steps.action: Cancel tomorrow's class
user_sees: The class leaves the week
must_not: A refusal for a class that has not started

steps.action: Try to cancel the class that already started
user_sees: A word that only the owner can cancel it now
must_not: The class cancelled

start: Admin app as a trainer, the week with another trainer's classes

steps.action: Look at another trainer's classes and members
user_sees: The other trainer's classes and the member names booked
must_not: A member's phone, fees or body numbers on a booking
Bookings of another gym
